jobs.title: Portfolio Manager - Executive Level (Ref: 197798)
jobs.description:
about the role

About Us

Managing public equity, private equity, and other asset classes, our client operates across a diversified finance and investment platform focused on long-term value creation. The organisation also takes stakes in promising growth companies and actively considers new investments, strategic partnerships, and joint ventures that can broaden and strengthen its portfolio. Based in Dubai, this organisation offers an executive environment where disciplined capital stewardship and informed opportunity assessment shape portfolio development.

Its investment approach combines oversight of established holdings with a forward-looking search for businesses and structures capable of delivering sustainable growth. The breadth of the portfolio requires sound judgement across different asset classes, markets, risk profiles, and ownership models.

Job Description

The Portfolio Manager will provide executive leadership across a diversified portfolio of public equity, private equity, and other investments. This position will guide portfolio strategy, evaluate performance, challenge assumptions, and ensure that capital remains aligned with long-term investment objectives.

Success will involve balancing active stewardship of existing holdings with the identification of attractive growth opportunities. The role will also contribute to decisions involving partnerships, joint ventures, and new investment structures, translating complex analysis into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders and supporting disciplined execution across the investment lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Set and refine portfolio priorities across public equity, private equity, and other asset classes.
Direct the ongoing review of investment performance, valuation, risk exposure, liquidity, and strategic fit.
Lead the assessment of promising growth companies and determine their suitability for investment.
Develop investment recommendations supported by rigorous financial, commercial, market, and strategic analysis.
Identify opportunities to expand or strengthen the portfolio through acquisitions, partnerships, and joint ventures.
Oversee due diligence, transaction evaluation, investment structuring, and post-investment monitoring.
Engage with investee companies, advisers, co-investors, and external stakeholders at executive level.
Present portfolio insights, proposed actions, and capital allocation considerations clearly to decision-makers.

Requirements

Extensive experience in portfolio management, private equity, public equity, investment management, corporate development, or a closely related discipline.
Demonstrated responsibility for diversified portfolios, complex investment decisions, or multi-asset capital allocation.
Strong capability in financial analysis, valuation, investment appraisal, risk assessment, and portfolio performance interpretation.
Proven experience evaluating growth companies and converting investment theses into actionable recommendations.
Practical understanding of partnerships, joint ventures, transaction processes, and post-investment value creation.
Executive presence with the credibility to influence investment committees, senior leaders, shareholders, and external partners.
Commercial judgement, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to make balanced decisions under uncertainty.
Excellent communication skills, including the ability to distil detailed analysis into concise strategic conclusions.

Benefits

Executive-level influence over a broad and evolving investment portfolio spanning multiple asset classes.
Direct exposure to growth companies, strategic investments, partnerships, and joint venture opportunities.
Meaningful scope to shape capital allocation priorities and contribute to long-term portfolio expansion.
A senior stakeholder environment in which investment recommendations can directly affect strategic outcomes.
Opportunity to work across varied investment situations rather than within a single asset class or transaction type.
Professional growth through engagement with complex commercial, financial, and ownership decisions.
A Dubai-based role positioned within a finance-led organisation with an active appetite for new opportunities.
Compensation and executive employment provisions aligned with the seniority and scope of the position.

Other

The position is based in Dubai and requires a portfolio leader who is comfortable moving between strategic oversight and detailed investment evaluation. Its scope will suit an accomplished professional who can protect and enhance existing holdings while maintaining a disciplined pipeline of new opportunities.

Applicants should be prepared to demonstrate clear examples of investment judgement, portfolio impact, stakeholder influence, and value creation. Experience across public markets, private capital, growth investments, strategic partnerships, or joint ventures will be relevant where it supports the broader mandate.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
Overview & Responsibilities

PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The principal activities are collecting, developing, analyzing, coordinating, directing, recommending, and presenting the results of the analyses to financial management, operations management and senior executives.

SPECIFIC JOB RESPONSIBILITES/COMPETENCIES

Accurate, consistent and timely reporting of financial data in accordance with regional and corporate schedules
Process ownership of Business Unit monthly outlooks, quarterly forecast and annual plan, including preparation and consolidation of financial information
Develop and maintain financial models for monthly outlooks, quarterly forecasts and annual plans
Complete informed variance analysis of actual results and forecast projections vs defined comparators
Inform and advise Commercial Financial Manager of all significant financial matters as they arise
Analyze to understand actual expenses and forecasts, trends and have input into any spend management actions required
Report information so that action may be taken to enhance operating results
Calculation of annual absorption & burden rates
Assist in the preparation of Capital plans and forecasts
Administration of capital spend requests
Preparation of the financial models to support capital expenditure
Oversee capital spending reviews to review financial performance compared to assumptions included in the justification
Other analysis as required on an adhoc basis

Background And Experience

Professional accounting qualification (CIMA, ACCA or equivalent)
Experience of management accounting practices
Must be able to demonstrate strong forecasting and planning skills covering the full P&L
Strong analytical skills and excel knowledge
The ability to work to strict deadlines with minimal supervision
Strong interpersonal, communication and presentation skills
The ability to explain complex financial information in a clear way
Previous experience with percentage of completion revenue recognition and absorption costing are preferred
4 - 6 years of relevant working experience in a multinational work environment.

Base Location & Work Schedule

This is a full time permanent position based in KEZAD Free Zone in Abu Dhabi. Hybrid work schedule - 3 days office, 2 days WFH (Monday - Friday).

The world turns to Ebara Elliott Energy.

Customers throughout the world choose Ebara Elliott Energy for the design, manufacture and service of their critical rotating equipment. EEE’s global service network routinely installs, overhauls, repairs, upgrades and rerates machines from any manufacturer. Customers everywhere turn to EEE for precision engineering, extraordinary reliability and unparalleled service.
